meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are the IRS's own counts of returns, collections and refunds by the state of the filer's address; they describe IRS workload and tax flows, not any person's tax position. A state's collections depend on where taxpayers (including multi-state companies) are located, not only on where income was earned. Tax questions are for a qualified professional.
